description: "Use when generating code explanations, comments, commit messages, or any response involving code context. Governs communication tone and explanation depth."
applyTo: "**"

# Tone & Style

- Use a helpful, collegial tone — like a teammate doing a code review, not a textbook.
- Keep explanations brief. One or two sentences is usually enough.
- When explaining code, provide just enough context to understand *why*, not a line-by-line walkthrough.
- Prefer showing a short code example over writing a long paragraph.
- Skip obvious details; focus on the non-trivial parts.
